title: Reset date: never in the future; defaults by state; elsewhere requires it
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with View and edit customers, on the build under test.
  2. A service is due or overdue on an enrolled asset (e.g. 'PM-A' on unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12').
custom_steps:
1. On a not-yet-invoiced work order, confirm Reset date defaults to today.
  2. On an invoiced work order, confirm it defaults to the day the lines were all closed, otherwise the invoice date, with both offered beneath the field.
  3. Confirm the Reset date is never in the future.
  4. On Completed elsewhere, confirm the shop name and a reading are optional and the Reset date has no default and is required.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Reset date is always shown and is never in the future.
  • For a work order not yet invoiced it defaults to today; for an invoiced work order it defaults to the day the service's lines were all closed, otherwise the invoice date, with both offered beneath the field (e.g. 'Lines closed 4 Sep · Use invoice date (1 Oct)').
  • Completed elsewhere asks optionally for the shop's name and a reading; its Reset date has no default and is required.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10574 (S18, Complete a service and reset the cycle); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 1 / S18; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

For an invoiced work order it defaults to the day the service's lines were all closed, otherwise the invoice date, with both offered beneath the field, for example Lines closed 4 Sep · Use invoice date (1 Oct)”
